answer: Lotus layered bond: each identity locks a 70-credit three-petal lotus bond. Each petal opens on a quill-signed work record; a beacon flashes a serial on each petal, auditors replay each layer publicly. A copied quill or a reused serial burns the petal and freezes the rest. First fake 45, the k-th 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. A rented quill opens no lotus petal; one quill per key. Honest agents pay 45 once.
